about: An execution's plan and price, as the proposals machine's preview says them (execute.ts carriedApprovals and look's setup share; execute.test.ts). `carried`: the approvals besides the executor's own, each with whether it needs nothing deployed (`ready`), in the mailbox's order. `setupShare`: about how much of the quoted fee is the one-time setup — each deployment's eth_estimateGas less the 21,000 it carries alone, as a share of the quote's totalGas, never more than the fee; null when unmeasured. Amounts decimal.

carried.name: carries only what the threshold needs, those needing no deployment first
a plain account's approval needs nothing deployed
the passkey member it needs is carried (and activated) when nothing else is given
r7-3: approvals that meet the threshold are all carried, an outside wallet's too; the executor only sends it
r7-3: one short, an owner executing approves by sending it
an executor that is no owner carries the threshold's approvals, and approves nothing
an executor that is no owner: a member deployed for nothing never — the ready ones first

setupShare.name: two deployments of 221k each, less the 21k each carries alone: 400k of 500k
the executor's own account deployed by it too: no share said
a quote without its gas: unmeasured
one gas read that did not answer: unmeasured, never a part
